Rooms.Name: In the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The warm humid air fills your lungs with the essence of the jungle.
You are surrounded on every side by the dense understory of a lush
tropical forest.  Screaming birds can be heard high above, their songs
intermixed with the sounds of larger, and more dangerous, animals
below.  The thick vines that embrace most of the tall trees may allow
you access to the upper reaches of the jungle's canopy.

Rooms.Name: Deep in the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The heat and humidity af the dense tropical forest make it rather
difficult for you to make your way through the heavy understory.  As
you gaze up at what should be the sky, all you see is the huge network
of leaf-covered branches and vines that make up the canopy.  This is
a place where myths become reality, and adventurers such as yourself
often spend an eternity attempting to explore the depths of the rich
forest.  The voices of the jungle call out in unison as you travel
through their home.  The jungle continues in every direction, and you
notice thick vines climbing the tall trees as they make their way to
the life-giving sky.

Rooms.Name: Deep in the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The tall trees gaze down at you as you travel through their home.
A sense of isolation creeps into your body as you realize that unless
you can find your way back to civilization, this jungle may become
a permanent adeventure.  The tropical forest continues all around you.
Thick vines wind their way around your arboreal companions on their
way to the sky above.

Rooms.Name: Deep in the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The tall trees gaze down at you as you travel through their home.
A sense of isolation creeps into your body as you realize that unless

Thick vines wind their way around your arboreal companions on their
way to the sky above.

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Dense Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The tall trees gaze down at you as you wander along the path through 
their home.  The still air is warm and humid, and you can only wish a
strong breeze would tear through this jungle in an effort to stir the
life within.  Thick vines wind their way up the trees along the trail,
offering you a foothold on their arboreal companions.  The trail
continues to the south, but it disappears without a trace to the north.
A very narrow trail cuts through the thick understory to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Narrow Path
Rooms.Description:
This path appears to have been made by repetitive use by some jungle
creature, and it is barely wide enough to allow you passage through the
unusually dense understory.  The lush foliage brushes against you,
despite the fact that there is no breeze forcing it to do so.  To the
east, there appears to be a clearing, and a slightly wider trail lies to
the west.

Rooms.Name: A Clearing in the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
This small clearing in the otherwise dense jungle appears to be
quite out of place.  An enormous tree stands at the edge of the
clearing, covered with unusually thick vines.  You feel the gaze of
many unseen eyes upon you as you examine the clearing further.  A soft
breeze caresses you from somewhere above, and when you look up you can
barely see the outline of some sort of structure at the top of the
enormous tree.  A very narrow trail leads to the west, and you are
surrounded by jungle on every other side.

Rooms.Name: Wandering Through the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The deceptively beautiful forest surrounds you on every side.  The
towering trees have silently observed many life and death battles in
this forest, inculding their own battles to survive against the odds.
Established citizens of the forest crowd out the smaller ones in their
fight to reach the nourishing sky above.  Thick vines reach up into the
lush canopy that blocks your view of that very sky.

Rooms.Name: Wandering Through the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The deceptively beautiful forest surrounds you on every side.  The
towering trees have silently observed many life and death battles in

Established citizens of the forest crowd out the smaller ones in their

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The small trail wanders through the dense jungle, offering you a
much safer means of travel than the forest that surrounds it.  The
sounds of the tropical forest surround you, and though it is quite
possible to leave the path, it might be safer to stay on it.  Thick
vines climb the trees that border the trail on each side, allowing you
a means to climb their branchless trunks.  The trail continues to the
north and south, into places unknown, and possibly dangerous.

Rooms.Name: Wandering Through the Jungle
Rooms.Description:

Rooms.Name: In the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
As you wander through the lush tropical forest, you can't help but
notice the beauty of your surroundings.  Trees surround you on every
side and smaller plants attempt to make their way upwards to the sky
above.  The damp ground is spongy with the life that teems on its
surface.  Large vines wrap themselves around nearly every tree in an
attempt to reach the sky that gives this place its energy.

Rooms.Name: In the Jungle
Rooms.Description:

Rooms.Name: A Small Path Through the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
The small path cuts through the dense tropical forest on it's
journey to places unkown.  It appears to be well-worn, but you can not
seem to find any sign of whoever made it.  The jungle extends to the
east and south, and thick vines might allow you to climb one of the
many tall trees that line the trail.  The path continues through the
thick understory to the north and south.

Rooms.Description:

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  Plants and
animals thrive far from the ground below.  The vines continue into the
canopy above.  Most of them also extend to the ground below, with the
scarce yet vital nutrients it offers.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards allowing you to
follow them in that direction.  You may also return to the relative 
safety of the ground below along the path of the vines that return in
that direction.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above.  From this vantage point, you can see that the 
inhabitants of the jungle have adapted to life in the various strata 
of the forest.  Plants and animals thrive far from the ground below.  
The vines continue into the canopy above, but thick foliage blocks you 
from climbing with them.  Most of them also extend to the ground below, 
with the scarce yet vital nutrients it offers.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards, allowing you to
progress further in that direction.  They also continue towards the 
relative safety of the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle

animals thrive far from the ground below.  The vines continue into the

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:

can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards, but the dense 
foliage will not allow you to progress further.  A large branch extends
to the east from the tree that plays host to the vines, and you should
be able to climb out onto it.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  The tree
that plays host to the vines you are climbing appears to have a large
circle carved into it.  The vines continue into the canopy above, and
some of them extend to the ground below, with the scarce  yet vital
nutrients it offers.

Exits.Description: The large circle carved into the tree appears to be an entrance.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines end abruptly here as if they had been cut.  They
do however extend to the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:

reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle

animals thrive far from the ground below.  The vines continue into the

Rooms.Description:

be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue upwards, but further progress in that
direction is impeded by the impenetrable foliage.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above.  From this vantage point, you can see that the 
inhabitants of the jungle have adapted to life in the various strata 
of the forest.  Plants and animals thrive far from the ground below.  
A large growth of some sort chokes the vines above you, and further 
progress in that direction is impossible.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  A large circle appears to have been carved into the side of the
tree that the vines encircle.  The thick vines continue their journey 
upwards, allowing you to progress further in that direction.  They also 
continue towards the relative safety of the ground below.

Exits.Description: The large circle carved into the tree appears to be some sort of door.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  Plants and
animals thrive far from the ground below.  The vines continue into the
canopy above.  Most of them also extend to the ground below, with the
scarce yet vital nutrients it offers.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards, allowing you to
progress further in that direction.  They also continue towards the 
relative safety of the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Enormous Tree
Rooms.Description:
Thick vines encircle the enormous tree, following it on its journey
toward the sky above.  A large structure of some sort appears to have
been built high above in the limbs of this tree, blocking your view of 
the sky.  The large vines continue towards the structure, and also
return to the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards, allowing you to
progress further in that direction.  They also continue towards the 
relative safety of the ground below.  The large tree that plays host to
the vines upon which you climb appears to be hollow, and a large circle
has been carved into its side.

Exits.Description: The large circle appears to be moveable.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  A strange
circle has been carved into the side of the tree that is host to the
vines you are climbing.  The vines continue into the canopy above.  
Most of them also extend to the ground below, with the scarce yet vital 
nutrients it offers.

Exits.Description: The large circle carved into the tree appears to be a doorway.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines continue their journey upwards, but the dense 
foliage impedes further progress in that direction.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  As you climb
the vines, you notice a large circle has been carved into this tree.  
The vines continue into the canopy above.  Most of them also extend to 
the ground below, with the scarce yet vital nutrients it offers.

Exits.Description: The large circle appears to be some sort of door.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  Although the vines continue toward the canopy, you cannot follow 
them because the dense foliage makes it impossible.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  A gaping hole
in the tree that plays host to the vines might allow you to climb into
the apparently hollow tree.  The vines continue into the canopy above.  
Most of them also extend to the ground below, with the scarce yet vital 
nutrients it offers.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  A large branch extends from the tree that plays host to the vines,
but it appears to be rather unstable.  The vines extend along the
branch, but they do not appear to continue upwards, and you cannot reach
the next branch from here.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
From this vantage point, you can see that the inhabitants of the jungle
have adapted to life in the various strata of the forest.  A strange 
circle has been carved into the tree that the vines call home.  The
vines continue into the canopy above, and most of them also extend to
the ground below.

Exits.Description: The large circle appears to actually be a doorway into the tree.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The view of the jungle from this vantage point is magnificent.  You 
can see signs of life in every level of the forest.  The air seems to
be slightly cooler and less humid the further from the understory you
get.  The thick vines end abruptly here, and you cannot reach the next
branch to continue climbing into the canopy.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines wind their way around the trees in an attempt to
reach the sky above, allowing you to follow their route to the canopy.
The tree that the vines are climbing echoes as you struggle to ascend, 
and you notice a large circle has been carved into its side.  The vines 
continue into the canopy above, and return to the ground below.

Exits.Description: The circle carved into the tree appears to be some sort of door.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The vines seem to climb into the very sky itself as you attempt to 
follow them to canopy.  You feel very dizzy as you look down at the
ground so far below.  Thick foliage blocks your way further into the
canopy of the jungle. A large sturdy branch extends south from the
tree, and it looks strong enough to hold your weight.

Rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
Rooms.Description:
You feel your balance falter as you attempt to move across the large
branch.  As you begin to slip and fall, you manage to catch hold of the
large vines that cling to the branch.  When you regain your balance,
and actually have a chance to survey your surroundings, you are in awe
of the beauty of the jungle.  Large birds fly past you screaming as you
invade their home, and you spot a small group of monkeys in a nearby
tree. If you move all the way to the end of the branch, you might just
be able to drop to the vines of the neighboring tree, or you can return
to the large tree to the north.

Rooms.Name: At the Top of a Tree
Rooms.Description:
The vines end abruptly as they reach the top of the tree.  This tree
is considerably smaller than the ones surrounding it, but it still races
to reach the sky and the sunlight it needs to flourish.  The air is much
cooler as you approach the canopy, and the humidty disperses as a soft
breeze blows gently through your perch. You can climb back down the
vines to the ground, or you can just stay here and enjoy the view.

Rooms.Name: At the Top of a Tree
Rooms.Description:
The vines end abruptly as they reach the top of the tree.  This tree
is considerably smaller than the ones surrounding it, but it still races
to reach the sky and the sunlight it needs to flourish.  The air is much
cooler as you approach the canopy, and the humidty disperses as a soft
breeze blows gently through your perch. You can climb back down the
vines to the ground, or you can just stay here and enjoy the view.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines continue into the canopy of the jungle on their way
to reach the sky.  Thick foliage obscures your view of the ground
beneath the tree that plays host to the vines.  The foliage becomes even
more dense above you, making it impossible to climb any further in that
direction.

Rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
Rooms.Description:
This large branch is covered with hundreds of ants, working
diligently to strip it of its leaves to use them for food.  The branch
extends several feet from the tree to the west.  A large tree is just
east of here, and you might just be able to climb onto it from this
perch.  The end of the branch appears to be very weak, so it might be
impossible to return if you decide to take that route.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You
see a large branch high above, but you cannot reach it from here in
order to continue to the top of the tree.  The least difficult route
would be to climb back down the tree to the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  The
dense foliage flourishes as you gaze up into the multitude of life in
the canopy.  Several large birds take flight from a nearby branch,
startling you and causing you to nearly fall to your death!  The sounds
of the jungle surround you on every side, and you can feel the gaze of
creatures hidden in the forest around you.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  The
dense foliage flourishes as you gaze up into the multitude of life in
the canopy.  Several large birds take flight from a nearby branch,
startling you and causing you to nearly fall to your death!  The sounds
of the jungle surround you on every side, and you can feel the gaze of
creatures hidden in the forest around you.

Rooms.Name: Climbing an Enormous Tree
Rooms.Description:
The heavy vines continue on their route into the canopy, allowing you
access to the very sky that brings this place to life.  Your view of the
sky is obscured by the large leaf-covered branches that extend from the
crown of this enormous tree.  To the east is a large network of vines
that connect this tree and the next one.  A large branch extends to the
south, and the vines continue towards the ground.

Rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
Rooms.Description:
The large branch is covered with thick vines and many smaller
branches.  To the north lies the tree that this branch extends from.
A small flock of parrots flies past you on their way to some avian
meeting place in the canopy.  You can hear the calls of their feathered
brethren above you.

Rooms.Name: Climbing an Enormous Tree
Rooms.Description:
The large tree that hosts the vines upon which you climb seems to
extend forever towards the sky.  The dense foliage of the canopy is
just above you and you can barely see the sky through the mutlitude of
leaves.  A large network of vines links this tree to the one just west
of it, and the vines continue into the canopy, allowing you to follow
their passage.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Enormous Tree
Rooms.Description:
The enormous tree extends upwards, but your view of the sky is
blocked by a large wooden structure that has been built in the crown
of the tree.  Far below lies a small clearing in the jungle, and the
vines encircling this tree might allow you to reach it.  The vines
also continue upwards, towards the large structure above.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You
see a large branch high above, but you cannot reach it from here in
order to continue to the top of the tree.  The least difficult route
would be to climb back down the tree to the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You
see a large branch high above, but you cannot reach it from here in
order to continue to the top of the tree.  The least difficult route
would be to climb back down the tree to the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point, and progress into the canopy above is nearly impossible.  You

would be to climb back down the tree to the ground below.

Rooms.Name: Climbing a Large Tree
Rooms.Description:
The thick vines that encircle this large tree end abruptly at this
point.  A large branch reaches down to you from above, and you though
you can barely reach it, it might allow you to continue towards the top
of the tree.  The vines return to the relative safety of the ground
below.

Rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
Rooms.Description:
This large branch is covered with hundreds of ants, working
diligently to strip it of its leaves to use them for food.  The branch
extends several feet from the tree to the west.  A large tree is just
east of here, and you might just be able to climb onto it from this
perch.  The end of the branch appears to be very weak, so it might be
impossible to return if you decide to take that route.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Vines
Rooms.Description:
The vines seem to climb into the very sky itself as you attempt to 
follow them to canopy.  You feel very dizzy as you look down at the
ground so far below.  Thick foliage blocks your way further into the
canopy of the jungle. A large sturdy branch extends east from the
tree, and it looks strong enough to hold your weight.

Rooms.Name: At the Top of a Tree
Rooms.Description:
The vines end abruptly as they reach the top of the tree.  This tree
is considerably smaller than the ones surrounding it, but it still races
to reach the sky and the sunlight it needs to flourish.  The air is much
cooler as you approach the canopy, and the humidty disperses as a soft
breeze blows gently through your perch. You can climb back down the
vines to the ground, or you can just stay here and enjoy the view.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
Rooms.Description:
The top of the tree is alive with the many creatures of the jungle.
A large flock of birds watches you from a nearby tree as you survey
your arboreal perch.  Tiny ants march back and forth across the many
branches that extend from the large tree.  You can see the outline of
a large wooden structure perched several trees over to the east.  The
vines that make their way to the top of this tree also return to the
base of it, allowing you safe passage in that direction.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
Rooms.Description:
The jungle canopy is filled with a multitide of tropical flora and
fauna.  A slight breeze cools your sweat-soaked body as it wanders in
from the east.  The tree upon which you are perched is covered with
vines that extend in every direction.  Several vines make their way
across to a neighboring tree east of here, and in that direction you
notice a large wooden structure has been built in the enormous crown
of the majestic tree.  The branches above you are too small to support
your weight, so you decide it would not be wise to continue toward the
sky.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
Rooms.Description:
The thick foliage of the jungle canopy surrounds you on every side.
The tree appears to extend several more feet into the sky, and you
see a large wooden structure built into it just above you.  A ladder
made of vines makes its way into the structure.  Several large vines
return to the base of the tree, and a few reach out to the tree that
neighbors this one to the west.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Jungle Canopy
Rooms.Description:
The crown of this large tree extends in every direction across the
jungle canopy.  Thick vines surround the many branches winding their
way back down to the ground.  The large branches sway in the breeze,
making any movement across them very dangerous if not impossible.
You can climb down the tree towards the ground, but the lack of a
sturdy branch above impedes further progress in that direction.

Rooms.Name: On a Large Branch
Rooms.Description:
The large branch extends from a mighty tree to the west.  You can
see several other branches above you, but they are just out of your
reach.  The drop to the ground below is rather dangerous, so it might
be best to climb the branch to the tree.

Rooms.Name: The Tree-top Hut
Rooms.Description:
The large tree-top structure appears to be a hut of some sort, made
by the secretive inhabitants of the jungle canopy.  It seems to be
quite deserted, but the remains of a small fire smoulder in the center
of the structure as if it was abandoned only recently.  A large wooden
door has been built into the northern wall, perhaps leading to other
tree-top huts.  A small ladder made of vines extends down from the hut
into the trees below.

Exits.Description: A small wooden door leads to places unknown.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
Rooms.Description:
The large tree appears to have been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small stairway winds around the inside of the
tree allowing you to move up or down.  On the western wall of the
arboreal shelter is a large circular door.

Exits.Description: The doorway leads to the outside of the tree.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
Rooms.Description:
The small shelter inside the tree extends all the way to the top, but
the stairway ends here.  As you gaze up into the top of the tree, you
notice a large nest has been built there.  Bits of feather float down
to you, landing like a soft snow at your feet.  The stairway continues
down into the tree.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Base of the Tree
Rooms.Description:
The inside of the large tree has been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  A small spiral stairway winds its way up around 
the inside of the tree.  An eerie light fills this part of the shelter, 
allowing you to see that it is in fact a small home.  A small altar
covered with twigs and leaves stands against one wall, and a mat sits
in front of it for sleeping or worship.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
Rooms.Description:

comfortable shelter.  A small stairway winds around the inside of the
tree allowing you to move up or down.  On the southern wall of the
arboreal shelter is a large circular door.

Exits.Description: The door leads to the outside of the tree.

As you gaze up into the top of the tree, you notice a large nest has 
been built there.  Bits of feather float down to you, landing like a 
soft snow at your feet.  The stairway continues up toward the nest and
down into the tree.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Top of the Tree
Rooms.Description:
The top of this tree is dominated by a large nest, surrounded by the
spiral staircase that runs around the inside of this shelter.  The nest
is filled with enormous egg shells, discarded by the young birds that 
must have been recently born here.  Large feathers line the nest, making
it a cozy place to raise young ones.  The small stairway winds its way
back down the tree below you.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Tree
Rooms.Description:
The large tree appears to have been hollowed out to form a rather
comfortable shelter.  The inside of the tree feels safe and warm, almost
like home!  On the southern wall of the arboreal shelter is a large
circular door.

Exits.Description: The circular door leads to the outside of the tree.

Mobs.Name: macaw blue jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A blue macaw flies past on his way through the trees.
Mobs.Description:
The blue macaw wears a beautiful azure coat that has been decorated
with patches of jewel-colored accents.  He has a strong beack, and
equally strong claws.  His poweful wings are capable of carrying him
to the tops of the jungle trees.

Mobs.Name: macaw scarlet jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A scarlet macaw calls to her feathered friends above.
Mobs.Description:
The scarlet macaw proudly wears feathers the color of freshly drawn
blood.  Her powerful beak and claws allow her to eat anything from
seeds to small animals.

Mobs.Name: jaguar black jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: The black jaguar crouches low, awaiting her next meal.
Mobs.Description:
With a coat the color of night, the black jaguar easily blends into the
darkness of the jungle.  She has extremely sharp teeth and claws, which
allow her to tear through living flesh with the greatest of ease.  Her
emerald green eyes stare back at you, and you just know she is thinking,
"Mmmm...lunch!"

Mobs.Name: peccary boar wild jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A peccary runs out from the underbrush and attacks!
Mobs.Description:
The peccary is compactly built, but very powerful indeed.  His tawny
hide covers a powerhouse of rippling muscles.  His small tusks can
gore anything he points his head at.  You thank your lucky stars that
this beast prefers the taste of plants, but don't count yourself
blessed yet -- he defends his territory with terrible ferocity!

Mobs.Name: frog poison bright arrow blue jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A brightly colored frog calls to his mate.
Mobs.Description:
The bright color of the poison-arrow frog serves as a warning to any
would-be predators.  He may be small, but the toxins in his skin pack a
powerful punch.

Mobs.Name: ant fire drone jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A fire ant drone runs through the forest looking for food.
Mobs.Description:
The fire ant has powerful jaws, but they are not her only means of
defense.  She is filled with an acidic poison that can burn the very
flesh from intruders.  You better hope she is alone, because as soon
as she calls for an attack, hundreds of her sister drones will attack
you, leaving only bits of hair and bone.

Mobs.Name: ant leaf cutter drone jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A small leaf runs through the forest.
Mobs.Description:
As you look a bit more closely at the leaf, you notice that it is
actually moving atop a tiny ant.  This little creature can cut apart
the forest with her powerful jaws.  She can also carry the resulting
pieces through miles of jungle back to her colony's farm, where the
leaves are buried to feed a crop of fungi.

Mobs.Name: runa man tribesman jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: Spear in hand, the Runa tribesman hunts for survival.
Mobs.Description:
This man of the jungle hunts only for the survival of his tribe.  His
people learned long ago that anything more would incur the wrath of
the jungle.  He is short and stocky, built for life on the jungle
floor.  His dark skin glistens with the humidity of the jungle, but
his sweat glands stopped working generations ago.  No point in
perspiring when the oppressive humidity of the jungle won't allow for
evaporation!

Mobs.Name: runa woman tribeswoman jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: The Runa woman wanders through her jungle home.
Mobs.Description:
The woman of the jungle has learned to live in harmony with nature.  She
gathers medicinal leaves for her tribe, taking only as much as they will
need.

Mobs.Name: monkey titi jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A small monkey scurries through the trees.
Mobs.Description:
This small monkey sits high above the jungle floor, escaping many of the
larger predators found below.  She is covered with a golden brown fur,
which has been matted along her tail.  While she may be small, she has a
fierce bite, and her mate is probably not too far from her.

Mobs.Name: iguana green jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: An emerald green iguana climbs slowly through the trees.
Mobs.Description:
The large iguana munches lazily on the bounty of leaves in his jungle
home.  While he doesn't care much for the taste of flesh, he is quite
capable of defending himself with his enormous muscular tail.

Mobs.Name: anteater giant ant jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant anteater tracks down some tasty morsels with his long snout.
Mobs.Description:
The giant anteater is covered with coarse gray fur, accentuated with
stripes of black and white.  He has a small head and a long,
pronounced snout, which is just perfect for hunting down his favorite
food - ants!  His long claws are excellent for digging into an
underground colony, and in order to protect them from damage, he
walks with his front feet turned on their sides.

Mobs.Name: sloth three toed three-toed jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: Covered in moss, the three-toed sloth climbs lazily through the trees.
Mobs.Description:
This tree-dwelling animal has hook-like claws, enabling him to climb
through the trees quite comfortably.  His reddish brown fur is covered
with moss, which has been able to take hold on him because he moves so
slowly!

Mobs.Name: tapir jungle
Mobs.LongDescription: The tapir munches his way through the tasty underbrush.
Mobs.Description:
This relative of the modern horse looks a bit more like a pig than
anything else.  He is short and stout, with a moveable nose, which he
uses to sniff out his favorite meal.

Objects.Name: skin jaguar runa
Objects.Description: A spotted skin rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A jaguar's skin is prized by the Runa for its beauty.  The roseated
pattern allows the jaguar to blend in with the shadowy jungle.

Objects.Name: dart poison poisoned runa
Objects.Description: A small dart glistens with deadly poison.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small dart glistens with the deadly poison of the poison-arrow
frog.  The poison is strong enough to paralyze a small peccary, and
may even do some damage to you if you're not careful!

Objects.Name: spear wooden runa
Objects.Description: A wooden spear rests in a pool of blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wooden spear is simply a long stick which has been sharpened at
one end.  With metal and minerals so scarce in the jungle, the Runa
use what they can to make weapons.

Objects.Name: pouch leather runa
Objects.Description: A small leather pouch has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small leather pouch appears to be used to hold herbs that have
been collected in the jungle.  The residue from several medicinal
plants clings to the inside of the pouch.

Objects.Name: sampaka leaf runa herb
Objects.Description: A small leaf rests gently on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small leaf comes from one of the many trees that grow in the
jungle.  It is used to make sampakatishi, which is used by hunters to
sharpen their senses.

Objects.Name: sampakatishi clay jar runa
Objects.Description: Simple, yet useful, this small clay jar contains a Runa concoction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clay jar is used to hold potions and remedies made by the
Runa.  Some may be useful, and some may be harmful, so beware!

Objects.Name: masero leaf herb runa
Objects.Description: A small blackish leaf rests on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The leaves of the masero are often used by the Runa to create nasty
potions.  This herb is considered by many in the tribe to be very bad
luck!

Objects.Name: maseropini clay jar runa
Objects.Description: Simple, yet useful, this small clay jar contains a Runa concoction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clay jar is used to hold potions and remedies made by the  
Runa.  Some may be useful, and some may be harmful, so beware what   
you taste!

Objects.Name: epi'kimi root herb runa
Objects.Description: A small root sticks up from the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This finger-like root comes from a rare tree that is found only in 
the homeland of the Runa.  The juice from this small root, known to
the Runa as epi'kimi, is mixed with several other herbs to make
potion that is used for healing wounds.

Objects.Name: epi'kimi clay jar runa
Objects.Description: Simple, yet useful, this small clay jar contains a Runa concoction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small clay jar is used to hold potions and remedies made by the
Runa.  Some may be useful, and some may be harmful, so beware what
you taste!
